exposure: timing of IUD insertion (during menstruation, breastfeeding, puerperal period)
cohort: 22 patients with uterine perforation after IUD placement and 30 patients with IUDs in place in the uterine cavity
finding: IUD insertion by a midwife and during the breastfeeding and puerperal period significantly increased the frequency of uterine perforation, while insertion during the menstrual period significantly reduced risk.
